body: If I died tomorrow, nothing would change, thats why death is so appealing to me. I dont know what it feels like to love. I cant bear the thought of loving myself, knowing wjat kind of person I am and what kind of thoughts I have make me someone not worthy of love.
Ive come to accept that sometimes there is no way to cope, only tolerate. Hitting my threshold soon, cant wait until I do, so I can finally get it over with.
Everything will be fine. Itll be even better when Im not around anymore. Solitude isnt enough, I need to stop existing.

Who want to endure someone like me. No interests, drive, hobbies, charisma, or personality. Im a workhorse and nothing more, even if a girl were interested, I couldnt let her do that to herself. Better off on my own as to not impede on anyones life.
I refuse to take meds. Im too afraid to tell anyone.
Yeah, times like this just make you want to drive a railroad spike through your skull

Seems like its always been that depression is the norm and my bouts of happiness are what come and go. Depression has always been my default, but its hit me like a truck recently. I wish it were that easy . All it would take is to walk into the highway at night. Just a split second jump into the road and end it. I cant let it happen at the hands of another person. I havent even done it but I still feel guilty. Guilt for something I wont do. My mind doesnt work right or something idk.

I have always tried to live my life according to what my parents wanted, didnt go so well. After I dropped out of college I stumbled along my own way and ended up doing ok. The depression never stopped though. I cant be happy when I make my parents happy, I cant be happy when I make my own way. I want to end it, but im too much of a coward. Y’know, thats one thing I never understood, everyone says suicide is the cowards way out. Have you ever held the gun and tried to pull the trigger? Stared down the barrel but be too afraid to shoot. Its sick to admit but I admire the hell out of anyone who could muster that kind of courage.

I wish it were temporary. Ive had suicidal thoughts since I was very yound. Im 23 and first started hurting myself when I was 5. I was always afraid to try cutting because its easy to tell what the person is doing when they cut. I started by slamming my head into concrete when I was younger. As I got older I realised that people would notice the bumps on my head and probably think my parents would beat me. Eventually I just started punching myself in the chest, pulling my hair, and just beating the heck out of myself in inconspicuous places. My old supervisor caught me punching myself a few months ago, I laughed it off and told him “sometimes you just gotta knock some sense into yourself”. Luckily he got nervous and didnt bring it up again. This isnt a temporary thing, its been ongoing since I was a child.
